description.value: Maude Hunter's Pub is a neighbourhood pub on Shelbourne Street in Victoria with an attached liquor store. It carries an extensive tap list spotlighting local BC breweries including Phillips, Hoyne, Driftwood, and Ile Sauvage. Weekly events such as music bingo, trivia night, and wing night give it a lively community feel, and a dedicated plant-based menu sets it apart from a typical pub kitchen.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is live and corroborates the OSM address (3810 Shelbourne St, Victoria, BC V8P 4H5) and phone (250.721.2337). Takeout is confirmed by the website's pickup instruction ('To place order for pick up please dial 250-721-2337 ex 13') and by menu items explicitly marked 'NOT AVAILABLE FOR TAKEOUT' implying others are. A dedicated plant-based menu page and gluten-free bun substitution confirm vegan/GF options. No evidence of bike parking, water refill, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or device charging appears anywhere on the website or in OSM tags.
concerns: OSM opening hours (Fr-Sa opening at 11:00) differ slightly from website (Mon-Sat 11:30am); website should be treated as current.
Venue is strictly 19+ with no minors permitted at any time — relevant for cyclists travelling with children.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active, publicly accessible neighbourhood pub with a confirmed website, corroborated address and phone, and regular programming. Useful stop for touring cyclists seeking food, drink, and takeout.

Takeout.detail: Website instructs customers to 'place order for pick up' by calling 250-721-2337 ext. 13; several menu items explicitly noted as 'NOT AVAILABLE FOR TAKEOUT', confirming takeout is otherwise available

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Dedicated plant-based menu page listing fully vegan dishes (Daiya cheese, Beyond Meat, vegan gravy, vegan mayo); gluten-free bun substitution available; Red Devil Veggie Burger described as 'soy free, gluten free'

wow_evidence: dedicated plant-based menu... local BC breweries including Phillips, Hoyne, Driftwood, and Ile Sauvage
